appendix.note: scripts/scan-dynamic-imports.mjs walks src/ with readdirSync/statSync, which follow symlinks; a symlinked directory inside src/ would be read too. Input is the repository's own tree in a developer or CI shell, never a request path — hard exclusion 5 (hardening without a concrete vulnerability).
The scanner's lazy-quantifier regexes ([\s\S]*? over <script> blocks, [^)]*? over import arguments) run on repository source only — hard exclusion 16 (no untrusted input in a request path).

optimizeDeps.include pre-bundles mermaid and qrcode at dev-server start; both were already runtime dependencies and are invoked by the same unchanged call sites (CanvasDiagram.vue keeps securityLevel 'strict' and the DOMPurify sanitizeSvg pass; QrCode.vue renders a TOTP URI). No production build effect.
The guard spec executes vite.config.js through resolveConfig inside npm run test:unit; the same frontend-build job already executes it via npm run build one step later. No new code execution surface.
workspace-model-choice.spec.js passes element handles into one page.evaluate and emulates reduced motion; test code against mocked routes (hard exclusion 8).
Added doc text names #2676/#2705/#2710–#2712 and OSS components only; the enterprise-docs-guard pattern matches no added line.
